```artifact
Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the system to compute and display alarms
  So that I can take action when necessary

  Scenario: High leakage alarm
    Given the system is running
    And the average leakage over 10 seconds is 3.1 L/min
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is high

  Scenario: High leakage alarm - edge case
    Given the system is running
    And the average leakage over 10 seconds is 3 L/min
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "high leakage" alarm is not active

  Scenario: High leakage alarm - invalid case
    Given the system is running
    And the average leakage over 10 seconds is -1 L/min
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then an error message is displayed

  Scenario: Involuntary shutdown alarm
    Given the system is running
    And the system is shutting down
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm is active
    And the alarm tone is continuous

  Scenario: Involuntary shutdown alarm - edge case
    Given the system is running
    And the system is not shutting down
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "involuntary shutdown" alarm is not active

  Scenario: AC mains power loss alarm
    Given the system is running
    And the AC mains power is lost
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "AC mains power loss" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: AC mains power loss alarm - edge case
    Given the system is running
    And the AC mains power is not lost
    When the system computes the alarm
    Then the "AC mains power loss" alarm is not active
```
